metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Golf Towels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly golf towels with your logo. Perfect for corporate events and golf outings. Fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton poly golf towels combine the absorbency of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them ideal for outdoor events where towels get wet and dirty quickly. The polyester fibers prevent shrinking and fading, while the cotton adds softness for gentle cleaning of clubs and balls. These blended towels hold up well to repeated washing and screen printing, ensuring your logo stays vibrant through many rounds. Choose from hemmed edges or grommet styles for easy attachment to golf bags.
